system.description:
Deal [(SR+1)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. The target takes a -5 penalty to [Physical Defense]. Treat this effect as a Bad Status.

(Fate 1): The penalty changes to -10.

A special skill that destroys the enemy's armor and skin with a powerful blow, dealing damage and lowering defense power. It is a technique that makes use of the weight of an ax or hammer.
